_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Re-measure the first-token cells. tabmemcheck forwards the seed to the row sampler on its chat branch and omits it on the completion branch, so those cells drew different rows for the two models — on adult-train the samples overlapped in one row out of 250 — which left them unpaired, irreproducible, and each judged against a baseline computed over its own draw. The seed is now bound for the duration of the call. Header and feature were unaffected and are not repeated.

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: its Russian adaptation, same cells; both run at once
